Strategy: Split residuals at fifty: roomy bins compete by worst fit while tight bins compete by best fit, with exact fits always winning. This prefers preserving tight bins when a roomy option exists but falls back to tight packing otherwise, though the fifty threshold is arbitrary and may misfire on small items.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else ((r - item) if r - item >= 50 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
